Andrew announced the removal of Jack as a supplier due to misalignment with Capital A's goals, emphasizing the need for transparency and proper deal closure. The team reviewed their active client pipeline, noting the importance of maintaining good relationships while focusing on closing deals, and discussed the better suitability of Apollo software over PitchBook for lead generation. Action items were assigned to Ahmed and Andrew, highlighting immediate tasks to improve client engagement and operational efficiency.
